name: io.github.ballostark-wq/bifrost-kfinance-mcp
title: Bifrost K-Finance & Korea Customs x402
description: Korea Customs HS trade, OpenDART filings, BOK FX/yields & AI supply-chain tools via x402 USDC.

tools.name: preflight_validate
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC] Deterministic pre-flight validator for JSON payloads, required keys, 5-field POSIX cron schedules, regex ReDoS safety, ISO-8601 timestamps, and target URL SSRF/syntax checks with a signed attestation hash.

tools.name: clean_context
tools.description: [$0.015 USDC] High-density HTML-to-Markdown distiller that removes scripts, styles, ads, and navigation noise while preserving pipe tables, links, and token compression metrics.

tools.name: kr_disclosure_radar
tools.description: [$0.06 USDC] Korean corporate regulatory disclosure radar (FSS OpenDART) translating KRX filings into English alpha signals: treasury buybacks, supply contracts, 5% stake flows, and CB/rights dilution alerts.

stock_code.description: 6-digit KRX stock ticker (e.g. 005930 Samsung Electronics, 000660 SK Hynix) or ALL

headlines.description: Optional Korean filing titles to classify into English signals

tools.name: kr_macro_pulse
tools.description: [$0.05 USDC] Bank of Korea (ECOS) macro & FX pulse returning live BOK base rate, USD/KRW and JPY/KRW exchange rates, KTB 3Y/10Y sovereign yields, term spread in bps, CPI, and exporter regime.

include_yield_curve.description: Include KTB 3Y/10Y yields and 10Y-3Y spread in bps

fx_pairs.description: Requested FX pairs among USDKRW, JPYKRW, EURKRW, CNYKRW

tools.name: kr_catalyst_brief
tools.description: [$0.08 USDC] US-to-Korea cross-border supply chain & catalyst intelligence mapping US tech/industrial tickers (NVDA, MU, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, LLY, LMT) or themes (HBM, POWER_GRID, DEFENSE) to Tier-1 KRX suppliers and key macro/earnings catalysts.

us_ticker_or_theme.description: US ticker (NVDA, MU, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, LLY, LMT, AVGO) or theme (HBM, POWER_GRID, DEFENSE, CDMO, EV_BATTERY, SHIPBUILDING)

include_calendar.description: Include upcoming Korea/Global macro & semiconductor catalyst calendar

tools.name: kr_customs_trade_snapshot
tools.description: [$0.025 USDC] Korea Customs HS 2-to-10-digit monthly export/import series (up to 24M) with HSK-10 sub-item share breakdown, export ASP ($/kg) & ASP YoY%, 3M MA, and KRX exporter tickers.

theme.description: Preset export theme: AI_MEMORY_HBM, POWER_TRANSFORMERS, K_BEAUTY_SKINCARE, K_FOOD_RAMEN, DEFENSE_ARMORED, SHIPBUILDING_LNG

hs_code.description: Optional custom 2 to 10 digit Korea HS/HSK code (e.g. 854232 or 8542321010)

partner.description: ISO 2-letter partner country code (e.g. US, CN, TW, VN, JP, PL)

months.description: Number of monthly observations to return (1-24, default 12)
